+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Bundle the Linux release binaries and adjacent data in one AppImage.
+# Provenance: linuxdeploy's AppDir and output-plugin documentation.
+set -euo pipefail
+
+root=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)
+cd "$root"
+if [[ $(uname -s) != Linux || $(uname -m) != x86_64 ]]; then
+    echo "package-appimage: Linux x86_64 is required" >&2
+    exit 1
+fi
+linuxdeploy=${LINUXDEPLOY:-}
+if [[ -z $linuxdeploy || ! -x $linuxdeploy ]]; then
+    echo "package-appimage: set LINUXDEPLOY to an executable linuxdeploy AppImage" >&2
+    exit 1
+fi
+if ! command -v convert >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    echo "package-appimage: ImageMagick convert is required for the 256x256 icon" >&2
+    exit 1
+fi
+bin_dir=${CAMCRAFT_BIN_DIR:-target/release}
+for binary in camcraft-ui camcraft-cli post; do
+    if [[ ! -x $bin_dir/$binary ]]; then
+        echo "package-appimage: missing executable $bin_dir/$binary" >&2
+        exit 1
+    fi
+done
+version=$("$bin_dir/post" --version | awk '{print $2}')
+if [[ ! $version =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    echo "package-appimage: unexpected post version '$version'" >&2
+    exit 1
+fi
+dist=${CAMCRAFT_DIST_DIR:-dist}
+mkdir -p "$dist"
+dist=$(cd "$dist" && pwd)
+work=$(mktemp -d "$dist/.package-appimage.XXXXXX")
+trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
+appdir="$work/CamCraft.AppDir"
+mkdir -p "$appdir/usr/bin/assets"
+for asset in posts machines ui scripts themes; do
+    cp -a "assets/$asset" "$appdir/usr/bin/assets/$asset"
+done
+cat > "$work/camcraft.desktop" <<'EOF'
+[Desktop Entry]
+Type=Application
+Name=CamCraft
+Comment=Computer-aided manufacturing
+Exec=camcraft-ui
+Icon=camcraft
+Terminal=false
+Categories=Graphics;Engineering;
+EOF
+convert assets/ui/cube.png -resize 256x256 "$work/camcraft.png"
+APPIMAGE_EXTRACT_AND_RUN=1 \
+LDAI_NO_APPSTREAM=1 \
+LDAI_OUTPUT="$dist/camcraft-$version-linux-x86_64.AppImage" \
+LINUXDEPLOY_OUTPUT_VERSION="$version" \
+    "$linuxdeploy" --appdir "$appdir" \
+    --executable "$bin_dir/camcraft-ui" \
+    --executable "$bin_dir/camcraft-cli" \
+    --executable "$bin_dir/post" \
+    --desktop-file "$work/camcraft.desktop" \
+    --icon-file "$work/camcraft.png" \
+    --output appimage
+test -s "$dist/camcraft-$version-linux-x86_64.AppImage"
+echo "AppImage: $dist/camcraft-$version-linux-x86_64.AppImage"

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Build a Flatpak bundle from the Linux release tarball.
+set -euo pipefail
+
+root=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)
+cd "$root"
+if [[ $(uname -s) != Linux || $(uname -m) != x86_64 ]]; then
+    echo "package-flatpak: Linux x86_64 is required" >&2
+    exit 1
+fi
+for tool in flatpak flatpak-builder tar; do
+    command -v "$tool" >/dev/null || { echo "package-flatpak: missing $tool" >&2; exit 1; }
+done
+dist=${CAMCRAFT_DIST_DIR:-dist}
+mkdir -p "$dist"
+dist=$(cd "$dist" && pwd)
+shopt -s nullglob
+archives=("$dist"/camcraft-*-linux-x86_64.tar.gz)
+if ((${#archives[@]} != 1)); then
+    echo "package-flatpak: expected one Linux release tarball in $dist" >&2
+    exit 1
+fi
+name=${archives[0]##*/}
+version=${name#camcraft-}
+version=${version%-linux-x86_64.tar.gz}
+if [[ ! $version =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    echo "package-flatpak: invalid version '$version'" >&2
+    exit 1
+fi
+work=$(mktemp -d "$dist/.package-flatpak.XXXXXX")
+trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
+mkdir -p "$work/stage"
+tar -xzf "${archives[0]}" -C "$work/stage" --strip-components=1
+test -x "$work/stage/camcraft-ui"
+cat > "$work/stage/io.github.NeoTech.Camcraft.desktop" <<'EOF'
+[Desktop Entry]
+Type=Application
+Name=CamCraft
+Comment=Computer-aided manufacturing
+Exec=camcraft-ui
+Icon=io.github.NeoTech.Camcraft
+Terminal=false
+Categories=Graphics;Engineering;
+EOF
+cp assets/ui/cube.png "$work/stage/io.github.NeoTech.Camcraft.png"
+cat > "$work/manifest.yml" <<'EOF'
+id: io.github.NeoTech.Camcraft
+runtime: org.freedesktop.Platform
+runtime-version: '25.08'
+sdk: org.freedesktop.Sdk
+command: camcraft-ui
+finish-args:
+  - --share=ipc
+  - --socket=wayland
+  - --socket=fallback-x11
+  - --device=dri
+  - --filesystem=home
+  - --filesystem=/media
+  - --filesystem=/mnt
+modules:
+  - name: camcraft
+    buildsystem: simple
+    build-commands:
+      - install -Dm755 camcraft-ui /app/bin/camcraft-ui
+      - install -Dm755 camcraft-cli /app/bin/camcraft-cli
+      - install -Dm755 post /app/bin/post
+      - cp -a assets /app/bin/assets
+      - install -Dm644 io.github.NeoTech.Camcraft.desktop /app/share/applications/io.github.NeoTech.Camcraft.desktop
+      - install -Dm644 io.github.NeoTech.Camcraft.png /app/share/icons/hicolor/256x256/apps/io.github.NeoTech.Camcraft.png
+    sources:
+      - type: dir
+        path: stage
+EOF
+flatpak-builder --user --repo="$work/repo" "$work/build" "$work/manifest.yml"
+flatpak build-bundle "$work/repo" "$dist/camcraft-$version-linux-x86_64.flatpak" \
+    io.github.NeoTech.Camcraft --runtime-repo=https://dl.flathub.org/repo/flathub.flatpakrepo
+test -s "$dist/camcraft-$version-linux-x86_64.flatpak"
+echo "Flatpak: $dist/camcraft-$version-linux-x86_64.flatpak"

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Assemble a universal macOS app bundle, portable ZIP, and disk image.
+# Provenance: Apple's documented macOS bundle layout and CamCraft's release assets.
+set -euo pipefail
+
+root=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)
+cd "$root"
+if [[ $(uname -s) != Darwin ]]; then
+    echo "package-macos: macOS is required" >&2
+    exit 1
+fi
+for tool in cargo python3 lipo codesign plutil ditto hdiutil sips iconutil; do
+    if ! command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+        echo "package-macos: missing $tool" >&2
+        exit 1
+    fi
+done
+
+version=$(cargo metadata --locked --no-deps --format-version 1 |
+    python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(next(p["version"] for p in json.load(sys.stdin)["packages"] if p["name"] == "camcraft-ui"))')
+if [[ ! $version =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    echo "package-macos: unexpected CamCraft version '$version'" >&2
+    exit 1
+fi
+dist=${CAMCRAFT_DIST_DIR:-dist}
+mkdir -p "$dist"
+dist=$(cd "$dist" && pwd)
+work=$(mktemp -d "$dist/.package-macos.XXXXXX")
+trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
+app="$work/CamCraft.app"
+macos="$app/Contents/MacOS"
+resources="$app/Contents/Resources"
+mkdir -p "$macos" "$resources/assets"
+
+for binary in camcraft-ui camcraft-cli post; do
+    arm="target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/$binary"
+    intel="target/x86_64-apple-darwin/release/$binary"
+    if [[ ! -x $arm || ! -x $intel ]]; then
+        echo "package-macos: missing release binary $arm or $intel" >&2
+        exit 1
+    fi
+    lipo -create "$arm" "$intel" -output "$macos/$binary"
+    lipo "$macos/$binary" -verify_arch arm64 x86_64
+    chmod 755 "$macos/$binary"
+done
+for asset in posts machines ui scripts themes; do
+    cp -R "assets/$asset" "$resources/assets/$asset"
+done
+install -m 644 RELEASE_NOTES.md TESTING.md LICENSE README.md "$resources/"
+iconset="$work/CamCraft.iconset"
+mkdir -p "$iconset"
+for size in 16 32 128 256 512; do
+    sips -s format png -z "$size" "$size" assets/ui/cube.png \
+        --out "$iconset/icon_${size}x${size}.png" >/dev/null
+done
+for size in 16 32 128 256 512; do
+    double=$((size * 2))
+    sips -s format png -z "$double" "$double" assets/ui/cube.png \
+        --out "$iconset/icon_${size}x${size}@2x.png" >/dev/null
+done
+iconutil -c icns "$iconset" -o "$resources/CamCraft.icns"
+cat > "$app/Contents/Info.plist" <<EOF
+<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
+<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
+<plist version="1.0">
+<dict>
+  <key>CFBundleExecutable</key><string>camcraft-ui</string>
+  <key>CFBundleIdentifier</key><string>org.camcraft.app</string>
+  <key>CFBundleName</key><string>CamCraft</string>
+  <key>CFBundleDisplayName</key><string>CamCraft</string>
+  <key>CFBundlePackageType</key><string>APPL</string>
+  <key>CFBundleIconFile</key><string>CamCraft</string>
+  <key>CFBundleShortVersionString</key><string>$version</string>
+  <key>CFBundleVersion</key><string>$version</string>
+  <key>LSApplicationCategoryType</key><string>public.app-category.productivity</string>
+  <key>NSHighResolutionCapable</key><true/>
+</dict>
+</plist>
+EOF
+plutil -lint "$app/Contents/Info.plist"
+
+# An ad-hoc signature makes both Mach-O slices valid on Apple Silicon.
+# Distribution signing and notarization can replace this when credentials exist.
+for binary in camcraft-cli post; do
+    codesign --force --sign - --timestamp=none "$macos/$binary"
+done
+codesign --force --sign - --timestamp=none "$app"
+codesign --verify --deep --strict "$app"
+
+name="camcraft-$version-macos-universal"
+ditto -c -k --sequesterRsrc --keepParent "$app" "$dist/$name.zip"
+mkdir -p "$work/dmg"
+cp -R "$app" "$work/dmg/CamCraft.app"
+ln -s /Applications "$work/dmg/Applications"
+hdiutil create -volname CamCraft -srcfolder "$work/dmg" \
+    -format UDZO -ov "$dist/$name.dmg"
+echo "macOS packages:"
+printf '  %s\n' "$dist/$name.zip" "$dist/$name.dmg"

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Wrap the Linux release tarball as a sideloadable desktop snap.
+set -euo pipefail
+
+root=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)
+cd "$root"
+if [[ $(uname -s) != Linux || $(uname -m) != x86_64 ]]; then
+    echo "package-snap: Linux x86_64 is required" >&2
+    exit 1
+fi
+command -v snapcraft >/dev/null || { echo "package-snap: missing snapcraft" >&2; exit 1; }
+dist=${CAMCRAFT_DIST_DIR:-dist}
+mkdir -p "$dist"
+dist=$(cd "$dist" && pwd)
+shopt -s nullglob
+archives=("$dist"/camcraft-*-linux-x86_64.tar.gz)
+if ((${#archives[@]} != 1)); then
+    echo "package-snap: expected one Linux release tarball in $dist" >&2
+    exit 1
+fi
+name=${archives[0]##*/}
+version=${name#camcraft-}
+version=${version%-linux-x86_64.tar.gz}
+if [[ ! $version =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    echo "package-snap: invalid version '$version'" >&2
+    exit 1
+fi
+work=$(mktemp -d "$dist/.package-snap.XXXXXX")
+trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
+mkdir -p "$work/stage" "$work/snap/gui"
+tar -xzf "${archives[0]}" -C "$work/stage" --strip-components=1
+test -x "$work/stage/camcraft-ui"
+cp assets/ui/cube.png "$work/snap/gui/icon.png"
+cat > "$work/snap/gui/camcraft.desktop" <<'EOF'
+[Desktop Entry]
+Type=Application
+Name=CamCraft
+Comment=Computer-aided manufacturing
+Exec=camcraft
+Icon=${SNAP}/meta/gui/icon.png
+Terminal=false
+Categories=Graphics;Engineering;
+EOF
+cat > "$work/snap/snapcraft.yaml" <<EOF
+name: camcraft
+version: '$version'
+summary: Computer-aided manufacturing
+description: |
+  CamCraft is a desktop computer-aided manufacturing application with a
+  command-line interface and post processor.
+base: core22
+grade: stable
+confinement: strict
+architectures:
+  - build-on: amd64
+parts:
+  camcraft:
+    plugin: dump
+    source: stage
+    stage-packages:
+      - libxkbcommon0
+      - libxkbcommon-x11-0
+      - libwayland-client0
+      - libwayland-cursor0
+      - libwayland-egl1
+      - libx11-6
+      - libxcursor1
+      - libxi6
+      - libxrandr2
+      - libxinerama1
+      - libvulkan1
+      - libgl1
+      - libgcc-s1
+      - libstdc++6
+apps:
+  camcraft:
+    command: camcraft-ui
+    desktop: meta/gui/camcraft.desktop
+    plugs: [desktop, desktop-legacy, wayland, x11, opengl, home, network, gsettings]
+  cli:
+    command: camcraft-cli
+    plugs: [home, network]
+  post:
+    command: post
+    plugs: [home]
+EOF
+(
+    cd "$work"
+    snapcraft --destructive-mode --output "$dist/camcraft-$version-linux-x86_64.snap"
+)
+test -s "$dist/camcraft-$version-linux-x86_64.snap"
+echo "Snap: $dist/camcraft-$version-linux-x86_64.snap"
